name: A_EXTRACT_IOCS
description: Deterministic, defang-aware IOC extraction (design §4 D-only counterpart to agentic triage). Input: text. Refangs (hxxp→http, [.]/(.)/{.}→.) then pulls URLs, IPv4s (octets validated ≤255), domains, and MD5/SHA1/SHA256 hashes — deduped. Domains inside extracted URLs are also listed under domains. Fully offline, no network ever.
